steps.content: EMP stands up straight and takes a few steps forward, but then she hears the gloating voice of Josh.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: You know, Stone Shadows are the less frightening monsters in urban legends. What do you think is waiting for you behind that door ahead?

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Is it an absorbing monster that sucks you in and turns you into a face on its back, a shadow-eating giant worm from another dimension, or a parasite that grows on you once it touches your skin?

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: But whatever it is, it must be thousands of times more frightening than the stone shadows here, right?

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Look at you. You are too scared to stand straight already. Can you really go forward? Tsk, I don't know how a coward like you became a FAC agent.
After hearing his words, EMP's face grows paler and paler. She clenches her fists but can't say a word.
Instead, Hella charges straight up and pulls EMP behind her, desperately suppressing her anger.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What do you know, you brain-dead, self-centered moron? Don't ever talk to her like that!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Say something like that again, and you can bug off on your own!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Disgusting!
Finishing her fierce speech, Hella strides away, pulling EMP with her.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: He's really not following us? That's strange...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Shh! Listen...
They pause, hold their breath and listen. And there are small clicking noises coming from behind them.
It sounds like broken porcelain tiles or some other hard objects scratching and moving across the floor.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hiss... I got goosebumps again. It's not a good sign...
The two exchange a nervous glance and slowly turn back...
Only to see a few severed stone limbs covering Josh's mouth and pressing him against the floor.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Mm... Mmmmm...
At the same time, directly above him, the rest of the pieces are rapidly converging into something unusually bizarre.
Slender tentacles reach out from the center, with fractured shapes embedded like a giant octopus reconstructed from various sculptures.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Woah! A weird and gross combo monster, like the ones in legends!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Really? This is ridiculous! And this... It's the most disgusting thing I've ever seen!

steps.speaker: Dahlia Guide
steps.content: It is indeed not artistic at all. Not my design.
The navigator speaks calmly, and there's actually a hint of contempt in her voice.
